translations.before: Controls if decorations are shown if the editor has git merge conflict indicators `<<<<<<<` or `=======` or `>>>>>>>`.

translations.before: Font family of inline message. [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensfontfamily). May break `#errorLens.alignMessage#`
translations.after: 行内消息的字体。 [演示](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensfontfamily)。可能导致 `#errorLens.alignMessage#` 失效。

translations.before: Font weight of inline message. (`"normal"` is alias for 400, `"bold"` is alias for 700). [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensfontweight)
translations.after: 行内消息的字重（`"normal"` 对应 400，`"bold"` 对应 700）。 [演示](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensfontweight)

translations.before: When enabled - shows inline message in italic font style. [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensfontstyleitalic)
translations.after: 启用后，以斜体显示行内消息。 [演示](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensfontstyleitalic)

translations.before: Font size of inline message ([CSS units](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/length)). Use negative value to have it relative to the editor's fontSize (e.g. `-3px`). May break `#errorLens.alignMessage#`. [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensfontsize).
translations.after: 行内消息的字号（[CSS 单位](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/length)）。使用负值可相对于编辑器字号进行调整（如 `-3px`）。可能导致 `#errorLens.alignMessage#` 失效。 [演示](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensfontsize)。

translations.before: Distance between the last word on the line and the start of inline message ([CSS units](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/length)). [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensmargin)
translations.after: 当前行最后一个字与行内消息起始位置之间的距离（[CSS 单位](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/length)）。 [演示](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensmargin)

translations.before: Align inline error message (either by starting position or ending position). Only works for monospace fonts. Set "start" and "end" to **0** to disable. ❗Will conflict with other extension decorations. [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensalignmessage)
translations.after: 对齐行内错误消息的起始或结束位置。仅适用于等宽字体。将 "start" 和 "end" 均设为 **0** 可禁用。❗会与其他扩展的装饰冲突。 [演示](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensalignmessage)

translations.before: Starting column where to align decorations.
translations.after: 装饰对齐的起始列。

translations.before: Ending column where to align decorations.
translations.after: 装饰对齐的结束列。

translations.before: Minimal space between line end and decoration. Very similar to the global setting `errorLens.margin`, but can only be a number of characters.
translations.after: 行尾与装饰之间的最小间距。类似于全局设置 `errorLens.margin`，但只能使用字符数。

translations.before: Very similar to the global setting `errorLens.padding`, but it can only be a number (not any CSS unit like pixels). First number is top+bottom padding; Second number - left+right padding.
translations.after: 类似于全局设置 `errorLens.padding`，但只能使用数字，不能使用像素等 CSS 单位。第一个数字为上下内边距，第二个数字为左右内边距。

translations.before: Use fixed position for decoration that has stuttering/twitching on the active line (e.g. when typing). Will prevent hover over decoration text.
translations.after: 使用固定位置，缓解活动行上的装饰在输入等操作时出现的卡顿或抖动。启用后无法悬停查看装饰文本。

translations.before: Border of the inline message. Examples: `1px solid`, `1px dashed`, `2px dotted`, `1px solid #00000050`... Set to empty string to disable. [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensborder)
translations.after: 行内消息的边框。例如：`1px solid`、`1px dashed`、`2px dotted`、`1px solid #00000050`……设为空字符串可禁用。 [演示](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensborder)

translations.before: Padding of the inline message. Visible when `#errorLens.messageBackgroundMode#` is set to "message". [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlenspadding)
translations.after: 行内消息的内边距。仅在 `#errorLens.messageBackgroundMode#` 设为 "message" 时可见。 [演示](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlenspadding)

translations.before: Border radius of the inline message. Visible when `#errorLens.messageBackgroundMode#` is set to "message". [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensborderradius)
translations.after: 行内消息的圆角半径。仅在 `#errorLens.messageBackgroundMode#` 设为 "message" 时可见。 [演示](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensborderradius)

translations.before: Customize which diagnostic levels(severity) to highlight. [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensenableddiagnosticlevels)
translations.after: 自定义需要高亮显示的诊断级别（严重程度）。 [演示](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensenableddiagnosticlevels)

translations.before:
Template used for all inline messages. Whitespace between items is important.

List of variables:

- `$message` - diagnostic message text

- `$count` - Number of diagnostics on the line

- `$severity` - Severity prefix taken from `#errorLens.severityText#`

- `$source` - Source of diagnostic e.g. "eslint"

- `$code` - Code of the diagnostic [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensmessagetemplate)
translations.after:
所有行内消息使用的模板。各项之间的空白字符会影响显示。

变量列表：

- `$message` - 诊断消息文本

- `$count` - 当前行的诊断数量

- `$severity` - 来自 `#errorLens.severityText#` 的严重程度前缀

- `$source` - 诊断来源，如 "eslint"

- `$code` - 诊断代码 [演示](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensmessagetemplate)

translations.before: Cut off inline message if it's longer than this value. (Improves performance when the diagnostic message is long). [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensmessagemaxchars)
translations.after: 行内消息超过此字符数时截断（可改善长诊断消息的显示性能）。 [演示](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensmessagemaxchars)

translations.before: Limit inline messages to the lines currently visible in the editor when a file has more lines with problems than this value. VSCode creates a separate set of CSS rules for every distinct inline message, so a file with thousands of problems can freeze the editor for a long time. Line highlighting, gutter icons, problem range decorations, hovers and status bar are not affected. `0` - no limit.
translations.after: 文件中存在问题的行数超过此值时，仅为编辑器当前可见的行显示行内消息。VS Code 会为每条不同的行内消息创建一组 CSS 规则，因此包含数千个问题的文件可能导致编辑器长时间卡顿。行高亮、边栏图标、问题范围装饰、悬停提示和状态栏不受影响。`0` 表示不限制。

translations.before: Replaces `$severity` variable in `#errorLens.messageTemplate#`. [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensseveritytext)
translations.after: 替换 `#errorLens.messageTemplate#` 中的 `$severity` 变量。 [演示](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensseveritytext)

translations.before: Controls whether inline message is shown or not (Including background highlight). [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensmessageenabled)
translations.after: 控制是否显示行内消息（包括背景高亮）。 [演示](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensmessageenabled)

translations.before: Controls how inline message is highlighted in the editor (entire line / only message / none). [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensmessagebackgroundmode)
translations.after: 控制编辑器中行内消息的高亮方式（整行／仅消息／不高亮）。 [演示](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensmessagebackgroundmode)

translations.before: When checked - highlight the entire problem range. [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensproblemrangedecorationenabled)
translations.after: 启用后，高亮显示整个问题范围。 [演示](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensproblemrangedecorationenabled)

translations.before: Controls which parts of the editor hover tooltip to show.
translations.after: 控制编辑器悬停提示中显示哪些部分。

translations.after: 启用后，在状态栏中显示高亮的错误／警告图标。 [演示](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensstatusbariconsenabled)

translations.after: 通过调整优先级数字，将状态栏图标向左或向右移动。

translations.before: Choose on which side the icons status bar is on: left or right.
translations.after: 选择状态栏图标位于左侧还是右侧。

translations.before: Which problems to use for counting problems at icons status bar.
translations.after: 选择状态栏图标统计哪些问题。

translations.after: 启用后，使用背景色高亮状态栏图标；禁用后，使用前景色。

translations.after: 错误／警告数量为 0 时，隐藏对应状态栏项或移除其背景色。

translations.after: 启用后，在状态栏中显示消息。 [演示](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensstatusbarmessageenabled)

translations.after: 通过调整优先级数字，将状态栏消息向左或向右移动。

translations.after: 选择状态栏消息位于左侧还是右侧。

Uses colors `errorLens.statusBarErrorForeground`, `errorLens.statusBarWarningForeground`, `errorLens.statusBarInfoForeground`, `errorLens.statusBarHintForeground`. [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensstatusbarcolorsenabled)

translations.after: 点击状态栏消息时执行的命令。

translations.before:
Template for status bar message. Whitespace between items is important.

List of variables:

- `$message` - diagnostic message text

- `$count` - Number of diagnostics on the line

- `$severity` - Severity prefix taken from `#errorLens.severityText#`

状态栏消息的模板。各项之间的空白字符会影响显示。

变量列表：

- `$message` - 诊断消息文本

- `$count` - 当前行的诊断数量

- `$severity` - 来自 `#errorLens.severityText#` 的严重程度前缀

- `$source` - 诊断来源，如 "eslint"

translations.before: Specify message to transform. E.g. if this is configured to [{ matcher: 'foo (.*)', message: 'just $1' }], the message 'foo bar' would be displayed as 'just bar'. [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensreplace)
translations.after: 指定要转换的消息。例如，设为 [{ matcher: 'foo (.*)', message: 'just $1' }] 时，消息 'foo bar' 会显示为 'just bar'。 [演示](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlensreplace)

translations.before: The RegExp pattern against which to match diagnostic messages
translations.after: 用于匹配诊断消息的正则表达式。

translations.before: The entire replacement for messages matching matcher. Can reference match groups like $0 (entire expression), $1 (first capture group), etc.
translations.after: 匹配 matcher 的消息将整体替换为此内容。可使用 $0（整个匹配）、$1（第一个捕获组）等引用匹配组。

translations.before: Change severity or editor decoration for specific problems. [demo](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlenstransmute)
translations.after: 为特定问题修改严重程度或编辑器装饰。 [演示](https://github.com/usernamehw/vscode-error-lens/blob/master/docs/docs.md#errorlenstransmute)

translations.before: Match with problem's message (case-insensitive).
translations.after: 匹配问题消息（不区分大小写）。

translations.before: Match with problem's message using Regular Expressions.
translations.after: 使用正则表达式匹配问题消息。

translations.after: 匹配问题来源，例如 `eslint`、`ts` 等。

translations.after: 匹配问题代码，例如 `@typescript-eslint/semi`、`6133` 等。

translations.after: 修改行内消息的属性。

translations.before: Exclude diagnostics by message. Excludes when the diagnostic message contains the excluding string (case-insensitive). Can use Regular Expressions (use object instead of a string).
translations.after: 按消息排除诊断。诊断消息包含指定的排除字符串时将被排除（不区分大小写）。支持正则表达式，此时需使用对象而非字符串。

translations.before:
Specify `source` or `source(code)` pair to exclude. Examples: 

```json
[
	"eslint",// exclude all problems from eslint linter
	"eslint(padded-blocks)",// exclude padded-blocks rule from eslint linter
	"Pylance(reportUndefinedVariable)",// exlude reportUndefinedVariable rule from Pylance linter
]
```
translations.after:
指定要排除的 `source` 或 `source(code)` 组合。例如：

```json
[
	"eslint",// 排除 eslint 的所有问题
	"eslint(padded-blocks)",// 排除 eslint 的 padded-blocks 规则
	"Pylance(reportUndefinedVariable)",// 排除 Pylance 的 reportUndefinedVariable 规则
]
```

translations.before: Exclude files by using [glob](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/glob-patterns) pattern. Example `["**/*.{ts,js}"]`
translations.after: 使用 [glob](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/glob-patterns) 模式排除文件。例如 `["**/*.{ts,js}"]`。

translations.before: Exclude workspaces by path.
translations.after: 按路径排除工作区。

translations.before:
Used for `errorLens.disableLine` command that adds a comment disabling linter rule for a line.
To force comment on the same line - add `SAME_LINE` to the message: `"eslint": "// eslint-disable-line $code SAME_LINE"`
